notes.test:garage: T2-201's behavioural RLS tier. Needs a local Supabase stack (`supabase start`, which needs Docker) and nothing else — no hosted project, no key. GARAGE_LIVE_REQUIRED=1 makes a missing stack an error rather than a skip, which is the point of running it deliberately. Plain `npm test` and `npm run verify` skip the same suites with a named reason. See tests/garage/harness.ts.
notes.pg: A devDependency, and only tests/garage/db.ts imports it. T2-401 needed two questions PostgREST structurally cannot answer: what the end-state ACL actually is (read from pg_class.relacl — the privilege that nearly shipped a hole in T2-202 was one nobody granted, so it appears in no migration text), and whether `authenticated` can TRUNCATE a user table (RLS does not filter TRUNCATE, and there is no PostgREST verb for it, so a grader could not even attempt the attack). The connection is loopback-only, checks the migration ledger to confirm it is this project's stack, and every probe that mutates anything runs inside a transaction that is always rolled back.
